name: agent_gemini_schema_sanitize_gemini_schema
notes: Recursive Gemini schema sanitizer (gemini_schema.c vs LIVE agent/gemini_schema.py). KNOWN DIVERGENCES (documented; inputs restricted to the agreed region): (1) typed enums with non-string entries — Py stringifies entries, C drops the whole enum key; (2) required names missing from this node's properties, or an empty valid set — Py filters/replaces/drops, C keeps required verbatim (no required filtering in the port); (3) 'items'/'properties'/'anyOf' holding a wrongly-typed value — Py drops or returns {}, C copies verbatim; (4) top-level non-object JSON — Py returns {}, C sanitize_node copies arrays/scalars through. All inputs keep all-string enums (or untyped enums), fully-valid non-empty required lists, and well-formed nested containers so both sides agree; the twin asserts its traced result equals LIVE output on every input.
